# Portable legacy GDL v209 test fixture

These source files and static Quick Run/Swift templates come from the preserved
v209 source package. Personal Windows home paths are replaced with C:/Fixture/GDL.
They are used only as package-import test inputs, never as the live Hub engine.
Processing algorithms are preserved; the original private baseline stays local.
This is a portable fixture, not a claim that historical private paths or the
original archive hashes match. Original-baseline comparison tests explicitly
skip when the privately held original is absent.
